items.title: Södra Port in Mönsterås benefits from energy-efficient LED mast lighting from CU Phosco
items.summary: Energisystem Sweden installed CU Phosco FL820 mast luminaires at Södra's Mönsterås port, cutting installed lighting power by 59 percent while improving quay visibility and operational safety.

items.title: Future Designs carbon careful™ initiative preserves existing luminaires across Crawley schools
items.summary: Future Designs' carbon careful programme replaced original fluorescent classroom fittings with LED across three Crawley secondary schools, prioritising retention and upgrade of existing luminaire bodies over full replacement.

items.title: Modeling When Light Matters Most for Circadian Health
items.summary: A new mathematical model of circadian response indicates that the impact of evening light depends heavily on daytime light exposure, with brighter daytime conditions increasing resilience to disruptive evening light.

items.title: IEA Article Describes New Era Of LED Lighting
items.summary: The IEA suggests the lighting sector is entering a second transition beyond the LED efficiency wave, though the article's specific technical or policy focus for this next phase is not detailed in the blurb.

items.title: Smart Home Trends For Multifamily Properties
items.summary: A Parks Associates whitepaper argues multifamily buildings are shifting from standalone smart-home devices toward unified building-intelligence platforms, positioning lighting controls as one component of integrated access, security and energy systems.

items.title: Lucent Lighting elevates rooftop escape AZOTEA Leeds with layered architectural lighting
items.summary: Mistry Lighting designed a layered scheme for AZOTEA, a Leeds rooftop bar, with luminaires supplied by Lucent Lighting to create distinct zones and atmosphere across the outdoor space.

items.title: FCC Approves Controversial Satellite Mirror Project
items.summary: The FCC approved a test launch for Reflect Orbital's mirror satellite, a space-based light-delivery concept that raises regulatory questions around light pollution, public safety and astronomical impact.

items.title: Will Mineral Paints Gain Traction In The Lighting Industry?
items.summary: Mineral-based coatings, valued for durability and breathability in heritage and eco-building work, are being floated as a possible premium alternative finish for luminaire housings instead of standard paint or powder coating.

items.title: Collingwood lights up Northampton Saints hospitality and net zero drive
items.summary: Collingwood Lighting completed phase one of an LED refurbishment in Northampton Saints' Barwell stand, replacing existing fittings across seating and hospitality areas to improve atmosphere and reduce energy use.

items.title: House Passes Bill To Create Permanent Daylight Savings Time
items.summary: The US House passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent; it still requires Senate approval, and the change would have implications for circadian lighting design and evening light exposure patterns.
